dedupe_keys.name: fwapg bc freshwater atlas spatial query tools

description: fwapg extends the British Columbia Freshwater Atlas with PostgreSQL and PostGIS structures for hydrological queries. Its README describes linear referencing of stream points, upstream and downstream searches, watershed delineation and gradients. Users load the official atlas and query coordinates or stream segments; outputs are linked flowline, catchment and basin geometry for the selected place. Geographic coverage is British Columbia and neighbouring source features loaded by an operator. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the extension; the official atlas has separate government data terms. A limitation is that a network topology inherits source mapping errors and may not show culverts, diversions or recent channel changes. The tool can prepare stream connectivity and watershed input for water-supply, flood or ecological-flow simulations. The related QGIS catalogue platform is general GIS software, not this BC-specific database extension. No atlas data or package was downloaded.
